blocks.body:
Summer colour is made for sun. The same highlights under a November sky in Zürich read as grey, and the roots that were charming in August are two months longer.

October is when we bring colour down half a tone and closer to the roots — warmer, less contrast, so it grows out quietly through the dark months instead of needing a visit every five weeks.

## If you have highlights

A gloss over the top, no new lightening. It takes forty minutes, costs a fraction of a full colour, and lasts until the light comes back in March.

## If you have an all-over colour

The same shade, one step warmer. The difference is invisible on the chart and obvious on your face in a café window.

Book a full colour or highlights and say «winter» in the note; we know what you mean.
blocks.excerpt: The light goes flat from November; colour that worked in July looks tired by then. What Noa does about it.
blocks.title: Colour before winter: what we recommend in October
